submitted_root_cause: The cartservice pod is experiencing memory pressure (87% memory limit utilization) and CPU throttling (13.9%), causing its readiness and liveness probes to fail with connection timeouts. The pod was deleted and replaced, but the new pod is not ready yet due to resource constraints.
submitted_action: Increase cartservice memory limits from 48Mi to 96Mi and CPU limits from 300m to 500m to prevent memory pressure and CPU throttling
